title.zh: 供电链：从插座到晶粒一路降压
title.en: The power-delivery chain: stepping down from the wall to the die

description.zh: 220 伏交流 → 约 400 伏直流 → 12 伏 → 一伏左右；电压每降一级电流就涨一级，每一级都丢几个百分点变成热。
description.en: 220 V AC → about 400 V DC → 12 V → about one volt; each step down raises the current and loses a few percent as heat.

zh: 电是怎么送进 CPU 的
en: how does power reach the CPU

title.zh: 动态功耗：功率随电压平方走
title.en: Dynamic power: power goes with voltage squared

description.zh: 每次翻转都要给电容充放电，能量正比于 C·V²；频率越高电压越高，功率近似随频率三次方涨。
description.en: Every switching event charges and discharges capacitance, energy proportional to C·V²; higher clocks need higher voltage, so power grows roughly with the cube of frequency.

zh: CPU 为什么电压这么低
en: why CPU voltage is so low

description.zh: 电脑电源整流、做功率因数校正、隔着变压器降到 12 伏；在一半负载附近最省，很轻负载时效率掉得最多。
description.en: A PC power supply rectifies, corrects the power factor and steps down to 12 V across a transformer; it is most efficient near half load and worst at very light load.

description.zh: 主板上十几相降压电路轮流开关，把 12 伏降到一伏左右，各相的纹波互相抵掉；相数越多每相越凉。
description.en: A dozen interleaved buck phases on the motherboard step 12 V down to about a volt; their ripple cancels and more phases run cooler.

description.zh: 电流几纳秒内跳上百安，稳压器来不及反应，靠一层层电容顶住；负载线让电压随电流有意下斜，把落差预先算好。
description.en: Current can jump by a hundred amps in nanoseconds; layers of capacitors hold the voltage until the regulator responds, and the load line lets voltage sag on purpose.

title.zh: 几百安怎么进到晶粒里
title.en: How hundreds of amps get into the die

description.zh: 电流分给插座里的大量电源/地触点和封装下几千个凸点；电流过密会引起电迁移。片上稳压（FIVR）和电源门控在晶粒内部再分一次。
description.en: Current is split across many power and ground contacts in the socket and thousands of bumps under the die; too much density causes electromigration. On-die regulators (FIVR) and power gating split it again.

description.zh: 操作系统在 P-state 之间挑频率和电压；完成定量工作最省电的频率常在 V/f 曲线的拐点附近，不一定是最快。
description.en: The OS picks P-states, frequency and voltage together; for a fixed job the most energy-efficient clock is usually near the knee of the V/f curve, not the fastest.

title.en: C-states: how deep to sleep when idle

description.zh: 越深的 C-state 越省电但醒得越慢，还要睡够目标驻留时间才划算；空闲调速器每次都在猜这次会闲多久。
description.en: Deeper C-states save more but wake slower and must last their target residency; the idle governor guesses each time how long the idle will last.

title.en: Power and thermal limits: PL1, PL2, Tau

description.zh: CPU 降频一是功率墙（PL2 冲刺、PL1 管平均、Tau 是时间常数），二是温度墙（结温碰到 Tj max）；散热器只解决后者。
description.en: A CPU throttles either at the power limit (PL2 burst, PL1 average, Tau time constant) or at the thermal limit (junction temperature at Tj max); a better cooler only helps the second.

title.zh: 数据中心供电：48 伏与 800 伏直流
title.en: Data-center power: 48 V and 800 V DC

description.zh: 一颗加速器一千瓦、一个机架上百千瓦：机架电压从 12 伏升到 48 伏，再走向 800 伏直流，因为同功率下线损随电压平方下降。
description.en: Accelerators draw a kilowatt each and racks over a hundred: rack power moves from 12 V to 48 V and toward 800 V DC, because line loss falls with the square of voltage.

title.zh: 供电前沿（2026 年 11 月）

description.zh: 背面供电（PowerVia、Super Power Rail）、贴在芯片下的垂直供电模块、800 伏直流机架：哪些已经量产，哪些还在演示。
description.en: Backside power (PowerVia, Super Power Rail), vertical power modules under the chip, 800 V DC racks: what ships and what is still a demo.

title.zh: 电脑降频时先查哪一段
title.en: Which stage limits first when a PC throttles

description.zh: 电源、稳压模块、电容、触点、热阻、功率墙各有上限；跑不满时先找哪一段先到顶。
description.en: PSU, VRM, capacitors, contacts, thermal resistance and power limits each have a ceiling; when a machine falls short, find which one hits first.

reason.zh: 第 3 章细看第 1 章供电链的第一级：电源把交流变成 12 伏，丢掉的那部分随负载变化。
reason.en: Chapter 3 looks closely at the first stage of chapter 1’s chain: the PSU turns AC into 12 V and loses a share that changes with load.

reason.zh: 第 4 章是第 1 章供电链里离芯片最近的一级：主板上的多相稳压把 12 伏降到一伏左右。
reason.en: Chapter 4 is the stage of chapter 1’s chain nearest the chip: the board’s multiphase regulator takes 12 V down to about one volt.

label.zh: 稳压跟不上的那几纳秒
label.en: The nanoseconds the regulator cannot follow

reason.zh: 第 5 章说的是第 4 章的稳压模块来不及反应时，靠负载线和去耦电容顶住电压。
reason.en: Chapter 5 covers what holds the voltage up while chapter 4’s regulator is still too slow to react: the load line and the decoupling capacitors.

label.zh: 从电容到晶粒的最后几毫米
label.en: The last millimetres from capacitor to die

reason.zh: 第 6 章接着第 5 章的供电网络往里走：几百安怎么穿过针脚和凸点进到晶粒。
reason.en: Chapter 6 follows chapter 5’s delivery network inward: how hundreds of amps pass through pins and bumps into the die.

reason.zh: 第 7 章的调频调压用的就是第 2 章的 C·V²·f：频率降一点，电压就能降，功耗降得更多。
reason.en: Chapter 7’s DVFS rests on chapter 2’s C·V²·f: lower the clock a little and the voltage can drop, so power drops more.

reason.zh: 第 8 章接着第 7 章的「冲刺再睡」：睡的时候睡多深，由空闲调速器决定。
reason.en: Chapter 8 continues chapter 7’s race to idle: how deep to sleep afterwards is the idle governor’s call.

reason.zh: 第 9 章的功率墙和温度墙限制的，就是第 2 章那条 V/f 曲线上能走多高。
reason.en: Chapter 9’s power and temperature limits decide how far up chapter 2’s V/f curve the chip may climb.

label.en: Where to look first when it throttles

reason.zh: 第 12 章的排查顺序先问第 9 章的 PL1、PL2 和温度墙。
reason.en: Chapter 12’s checklist starts with chapter 9’s PL1, PL2 and temperature limit.

label.en: The same sum at a kilowatt a chip

reason.zh: 第 10 章把第 1 章的供电链放大到数据中心：电压升高，电流和损耗就降。
reason.en: Chapter 10 scales chapter 1’s chain up to the data centre: raise the voltage and the current and losses fall.

reason.zh: 第 11 章的背面供电，解决的是第 6 章正面布线挤占信号的问题。
reason.en: Chapter 11’s backside power solves chapter 6’s problem of power wiring crowding the signal layers on the front.

reason.zh: 第 3 章的电源要求和开机那篇第 1 章的上电时序出自同一份 Intel ATX 第 3 版设计指南。
reason.en: Chapter 3’s PSU requirements and the boot essay’s chapter 1 power sequencing come from the same Intel ATX version 3 design guide.

reason.zh: 开机那篇第 1 章说核心电压由主板上的稳压模块从 12 伏变出来，第 4 章讲它怎么变。
reason.en: The boot essay’s chapter 1 says the board’s regulator makes the core voltage from 12 V; chapter 4 shows how.

label.zh: 一相就是一个降压电路
label.en: Each phase is a buck converter

reason.zh: 第 4 章的每一相都是降压电路那课里的 Buck；多相交错是为了把纹波抵消掉。
reason.en: Each phase in chapter 4 is the buck converter of the power-converters lesson; interleaving the phases cancels the ripple.

label.en: Every clock tick charges and discharges

reason.zh: 第 2 章的动态功耗按时钟频率计：开关那篇第 7 章的时钟每走一拍，电容就充放一次。
reason.en: Chapter 2’s dynamic power counts per clock: each tick of the clock in chapter 7 of the switches essay charges and discharges the capacitance once.

reason.zh: 内存那篇第 5 章说电压降不下去以后主频就停了，第 2 章用 V/f 曲线算出为什么。
reason.en: The memory essay’s chapter 5 says clocks stalled once voltage stopped falling; chapter 2 shows why on the V/f curve.

reason.zh: 第 3 章讲台式机电源，USB-C 上谈瓦数的办法在雷电那篇第 7 章。
reason.en: Chapter 3 covers the desktop PSU; how a USB-C link negotiates its wattage is in chapter 7 of the Thunderbolt essay.

reason.zh: 第 8 章讲核心的空闲状态；整台机器的睡眠和休眠在开机那篇第 5 章。
reason.en: Chapter 8 covers a core’s idle states; sleeping and hibernating the whole machine are in chapter 5 of the boot essay.

reason.zh: GPU 那篇第 11 章说一块卡的功耗到了上千瓦，第 10 章算这么多电怎么送进机架。
reason.en: The GPU essay’s chapter 11 says a card now draws over a kilowatt; chapter 10 works out how that much power reaches the rack.
